parameters.content:
## 2.0 QR Code Page - Config

'Fetch Event' looks up the event and its sessions; 'Build QR Page' draws the QR and inlines the QR library (no external calls); 'Add Save/Print Buttons' turns that into the finished page and adds the buttons. You should not need to open those nodes.

**BASE_URL** (required) - the check-in form URL each code encodes: https://YOUR-N8N-HOST/form/<3.0 Form Trigger webhook id>. Replace YOUR-N8N-HOST with your n8n host. Re-check it whenever 3.0's Form Trigger is recreated, because printed codes carry this address.
**GRAPHQL_URL** (required) - Administrate GraphQL endpoint used by 'Fetch Event' (needs your Administrate OAuth2 credential).

**QR_MODE** - 'session' (default) prints one code per session, each encoding eventId + that session's sessionId. 'event' prints a single code carrying eventId only. 3.0 handles either: it honours the scanned session when its check-in window is open, otherwise it uses the open session on that event nearest its start.

URL parameters, appended to this page's address by hand:
  **&mode=session** or **&mode=event** - overrides QR_MODE for one page load.
  **&sessionId=<id>** - one code, that session only.
  **&date=YYYY-MM-DD** - codes for sessions on that local date.
  **&from=** / **&to=YYYY-MM-DD** - codes across a date range.
Any filter implies session mode. Dates are compared in each session's OWN timezone.

**Two deliberate refusals.** Opening this page with no ?eventId= shows 'No event selected' instead of a code. A filter matching nothing shows 'No matching sessions'. Neither falls back to a working-looking code, because a code for the wrong event or session looks identical to the right one once printed.

**TITLE** - fallback heading when no event is found; the event's real title replaces it otherwise.
**HEADER** - sub-heading under the title.
**BODY** / **FOOTER** - optional text under the codes / small print (blank = hidden).
**ALT_TEXT** - accessibility description of the QR images.
**LOGO** - optional data: URL (e.g. a small PNG/WebP) drawn in the centre of each QR. Blank = no logo.
**TIME_24H** - off = 12-hour (9:30am), on = 24-hour (09:30).
**START_LABEL / DATE_FORMAT** - legacy, unused. Each session caption carries its own date and time.

Session caption is three lines: event name, date and time, then the session id, so a printed sheet can be traced to an exact session. A session crossing midnight shows its end date too.

Save / Print: **SHOW_SAVE_BUTTON / SHOW_PRINT_BUTTON** toggles, **SAVE_LABEL / PRINT_LABEL** text. Save downloads one PNG per code, named **FILE_PREFIX**-<eventId>. Print puts one code per page. Colours and QR size are constants at the top of 'Build QR Page'.

**Browser note:** the QR is drawn to a canvas and converted with toDataURL(). Firefox with anti-fingerprinting on returns a blank image with no error. Print codes from Edge or Chrome.

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ query: "query EventInfo($eventId:String!){ events(filters:[{field:id,operation:eq,value:$eventId}]){ edges{ node{ id title start timeZonedStart sessions{ edges{ node{ id title timeZoneName start timeZonedStart timeZonedEnd } } } } } } }", variables: { eventId: ($('QR Page (Webhook)').item.json.query.eventId || '').toString().trim() } }) }}
